LanguageData.MS_Caravan_NoTeleporter: This network has no caravan teleporter.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_OpenDesc: Choose caravan members and supplies from the connected magic storage network. The caravan departs immediately after confirmation.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_Unavailable: The caravan teleporter's storage network is unavailable or has changed. Reset the selection or reopen the window.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_StockChanged: Some selected supplies are no longer available in the storage network. Reset the selection and try again.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_PawnsChanged: Some selected caravan members are no longer available. Reset the selection and try again.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_LayerUnavailable: A caravan cannot be formed at this world location.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_TransferFailed: An error occurred during caravan teleportation. Supplies have been preserved. Check the current caravan and its members before trying again.
LanguageData.MS_Caravan_CannotDropCarried: A selected caravan member cannot put down what they are carrying. Clear their hands and try again.
